But they will grow into something more. Players do not

Before the prologue, create the five starting characters.
As you play the campaign, you may find new characters
that will use the other five Character cards.
ASGARD
To create a new character:
1. Take a blank Character card.
2. Choose a job and place the sticker onto the
Job box on your Character card.
Newt
3. Choose an image sticker for your character and
place it as your Character card's photo.
4. Name the character and give them an age.
5. Choose one of the named havens as their home.
Do not fill in the place of death. That may come to pass
as your characters gain exposure. As you scratch off the
Exposure track on your Character card, you may reveal
scars or a skull. But not now. Not yet.
Asgard
